system.name: GASP
system.one_liner: A black-box framework that trains a suffix generator with latent Bayesian optimization and ORPO to produce human-readable adversarial suffixes for jailbreaking LLMs.

content.variant_note: four lettered phases around one tall central bar for the shared SuffixLLM, with sketched density curves showing the distribution being reshaped
content.argues: Pre-training, latent-space search and ORPO refinement of one suffix generator move its output distribution from a generic baseline to one aligned with the black-box target LLM.
content.subject: Four phases (pre-training, training and alignment, inference and refinement, results) that all act on the SuffixLLM, with suffix strips and distribution curves.

lessons.what_to_learn: When several stages all act on one model, draw that model as one tall central bar and hang the lettered stages on both sides, so every arrow visibly starts or ends at the same object; show what a stage does to it with sketched density curves (baseline to aligned, matched to the target).
lessons.suits: Multi-stage training or attack pipelines that share one generator or policy and reshape its output distribution stage by stage.

evidence: GASP first pretrains SuffixLLM gϕ on a collection of generic but coherent adversarial suffixes to establish a good initialization
efficiently searching for strong candidate adversarial suffixes using LBO with real-time feedback from the TargetLLM
the final SuffixLLM’s output distribution is expected to align with TargetLLM

summary: GASP is a black-box jailbreak framework that generates human-readable adversarial suffixes: a suffix generator, SuffixLLM, is pre-trained, then refined by searching a latent space with Bayesian optimization and finetuning with ORPO. Figure 1 puts a tall gradient bar named SuffixLLM in the middle and hangs four lettered sections round it. (A) pre-trains it on AdvSuffixes to fit a generic baseline distribution; (B) turns generated suffixes into a latent space, picks the most effective ones via LBO and GASPEval and uses ORPO to reshape the distribution from baseline to aligned; (C) generates aligned suffixes for a black-box LLM and refines further; (D) shows the aligned distribution matching the target. Token strips use green and red cells; yellow pills mark ORPO.
summary_zh: GASP 是黑盒越狱框架：先预训练后缀生成器 SuffixLLM，再用潜空间贝叶斯优化挑选有效后缀、用 ORPO 微调。图中央是一根高渐变条 SuffixLLM，四个字母分区环绕，用绿红格子的后缀条和黄色 ORPO 药丸表示对齐过程。
